svg.text: F04 the three NAND master latches side by side: DUT2 baseline, DUT3 keeper x2, DUT4 forward x2
With g1 = g2 = 1 (clock high, door closed) each NAND is an inverter: forward u_mfw drives mq from mqb, keeper u_mkp drives mqb from mq.
Only the red-bracketed gates differ. tau: 88.9 ps (DUT2), 80.5 ps (DUT3), 102.3 ps (DUT4).
Names: 2/3/4 = DUT2/3/4, f = forward u_mfw, k = keeper u_mkp; P/N = PMOS/NMOS. The gates g1, g2 come from the master door (F05); F01-F03 show them as inputs.
Rails: VDD at the top, VSS at the bottom; every PMOS body is on VDD and every NMOS body on VSS (drawn inside the symbol). A dot marks a connection; wires that cross without a dot are not connected.
